text:
alex: Hey folks — opened PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/pull/4123. Changes: prefetched KV eviction + batcher queue tweak to avoid head-of-line stalls. Need a quick audit: perf microbench + correctness (race on evict). Hoping for review today so we can canary tomorrow.

elena: PTAL in the morning. main concern is eviction ordering and codepath on empty cache.

morgan: I can look briefly. Do we have reproduction steps? any flaky test?

alex: Repro instructions in PR description. Copying snippet:
```
# repro
RUN_EVAL=1 ./tools/smoke --profile=kvcache --seq-len=512 --clients=16
```
Also added unit test kvcache/test_eviction.py — but it's timing sensitive.

raj: read it. quick note: the batcher change increments the max_wait_ms from 10 -> 20, will that affect latency tail? need numbers.

alex: Good call — ran local perf: p99 token latency increased ~1.8ms on small requests, throughput up ~6% under load. I left the perf CSV in PR.

morgan: if p99 impact is small, OK if we do canary with traffic split 5%. Who owns canary?

elena: I can own canary tomorrow 10:30am PT. Plan: 1) deploy to canary pool, 2) run smoke matrix (kvcache, batching, seq lengths 64/512), 3) monitor p99 & error rate for 30m, 4) rollback on >10% p99 or >0.1% error delta.

alex: Perfect. @morgan can you give LGTM on tests? @raj can you sanity check eviction ordering?

raj: Skimmed changes — left inline comment about using OrderedDict vs deque. I think it's fine but add that comment.

morgan: LGTM on tests, small nits but not blocking. :thumbsup: 

carol-ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit tests, linters). build 9842.

alex: thanks — merging after addressing raj inline. Will post rollout plan in #eng-oncall before deploy. :rocket:
